data.one_liner: Flutter toolkit for WalletConnect onchain UX
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets and flows to connect wallets, manage deposits, exchanges, and authentication on Ethereum and Solana chains. It wraps reown_core and reown_sign for secure wallet interactions.
use_when: You need a ready‑made UI for wallet connection and onchain flows
You want to support multiple chains (EVM and Solana) with a single package
You prefer declarative Flutter widgets over custom implementations
avoid_when: You need fine‑grained control over wallet logic beyond the provided flows
You are building a non‑wallet related app and want minimal dependencies
strengths: Built on top of WalletConnect Network for broad compatibility
weaknesses: Limited customization of UI beyond provided widgets
data.setup_notes: Add package to pubspec, run flutter pub get. No build_runner needed. Requires Android SDK 23+ and iOS deployment target 12.0+. No special permissions beyond those of underlying wallet SDKs.
